notes.title: 1.7 hotfix #2
notes.notes: [h2]Small Fixes, Future Plans[/h2][p][/p][h3]Hello Hunters![/h3][p]We hope you’ve been enjoying your beach trips and Yomi adventures. Whether you’ve been with us since the start or just joined us—we thank you! We want to let everyone know that we’ve been listening closely to your feedback, especially from recent reviews and comments.[/p][p]This patch is a small but important first step in improving the overall experience of A DAY OUT. More specifically, for SOLO players. We’ve got more improvements on the way of course, like quality of life features, gameplay tweaks, and much more. We’ll make sure to share as much as we can as we progress, so keep an eye out for updates / announcements in our discord server![/p][p]Once again, thank you for playing, for your feedback, and for sticking with us. It means the world to us![/p][p]So as always, stay cool, stay safe, and happy hunting![/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/3cf5ba0b9356688163cd68128ce3da2377e9c1c8.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/f1b90e26eba74d7d4fc4b424fbb1401b7c42dca1.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/53e4713f358ccdde859ff06f6d351a9842255d7a.jpg"][/img][/carousel][h2]Improvements:[/h2][list][*][p]Added slow motion when opening the tablet in singleplayer[/p][/*][*][p]Added body camera to inventory for all players[/p][/*][*][p]Added auto reload when magazine reaches zero[/p][/*][*][p]Increased damage multiplier when playing singleplayer[/p][/*][*][p]Removed Fireworks from FOB[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly Tweaked FOB Kitchen[/p][/*][*][p]Renamed ‘EDM’ Radio Station to PartyPopperZ[/p][/*][*][p]Added 4 New Tracks to PartyPopperZ[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed Oni ragdoll issue when being secured[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 1.7 hotfix #1
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello Hunters! [/h2][h3]We hope you’ve been enjoying your Day Out in Yomi—we know we have. Huge thanks to everyone who's taken time out of their summer to help take down that fearsome Oni. Don't get too excited though... we're just tuning things up a bit.
 [/h3][p][/p][h2]Back to the beach![/h2][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/e45871c38a1b1a0da0ea2ba6d7dbe481f793754a.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/41b3f17977f76bed9a5107c5c3875b9872935279.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p][i]Head to the beach for some fun in the sun.[/i] [i]You can access the beach from the FOB.[/i][/p][p][/p][h2]Map Updates:[/h2][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/66e6063c82fe2ea078514f951eafd5c3c1c0bed0.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/2caeddef16c010020e6f994605c68d1a08a94e53.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p][i]New voice lines for both the Missing Twins case and the Purgatory case.[/i][/p][p][/p][h2]Improvements:[/h2][list][*][p]Added New Swim Mask to the Beach Map – Now you can dive in with style[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced All ‘Ominous’ Voices in Missing Twins and Cult of the Sacred Seraphim[/p][/*][*][p]Locked Yokai Traps Until Binding Charm Is Acquired in Land of the Dead[/p][/*][*][p]Beach Map Party Mode Activated[/p][/*][*][p]Added Failsafe to ‘Sanzu Passage’ in Land of the Dead – Late arrivals no longer get left in the void[/p][/*][*][p]New Intro Music for Missing Twins and Cult of the Sacred Seraphim[/p][/*][*][p]New ‘Cookout’ Decorations added to the FOB – Fire up the grill, Hunters[/p][/*][*][p] Renamed ‘Chupacabra Canyon’ to American Chupacabra – Now with more yeehaw[/p][/*][*][p]New Encounter Music added to the Beach Map – Groove with the crabs[/p][/*][*][p]New Radio Added to the Beach – Tune in, chill out[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Beach Wardrobe Visibility – Better fits, brighter days[/p][/*][*][p]Added HUD Animation [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed Minor Lighting Issue in Land of the Dead case. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Xenoraptor’s Acid in the Prologue – No more surprise insta-deaths. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Xenoraptor Pathfinding in the Prologue – He’s a bit smarter now… just a bit. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Animation Bug when rolling after firing – Only in multiplayer, of course. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Issue Preventing Tablet Use on Quads – You can now multitask like a real hunter. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed walking with emotes still playing[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed getting stuck after shooting or reloading with emotes playing[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed mouse cursor not auto focusing the game after map loading[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed tutorial outro cinematic not capturing mouse[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed slime droppings doing repeated damage and quickly killing the player[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an Issue Causing Goob to Steal the Quads in the FOB[/p][/*][/list][p]
[i]As always, thank you for the support. Stay cool, stay safe, and happy hunting![/i][/p]

[h1]Merry Cryptid Christmas, Hunters!![/h1]
[h3]The holiday season has arrived, and we’ve packed this update with festive cheer and exciting new changes. From snowy landscapes to glimmering cryptid eyes, there’s plenty to discover and enjoy this season.[/h3]

[h2]Holiday Cosmetics[/h2]

[list]
[*] New Christmas Cosmetics – Dress up in festive style with our latest gear.
[*] New Christmas FOB Base Theme – Transform your base into a cozy holiday retreat.
[*] Christmas FOB Decorations – Deck the halls (and your base) with seasonal cheer.
[/list]

[h2]Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] FOB Weather Update – Experience the magic of snowfall at your base this holiday season.
[*] Double Payout for T’s Xmas Case – Earn double rewards for a limited time in this seasonal favorite!
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Bigfoot Bug Fix – Bigfoot is no longer vulnerable to silver-tipped bullets. Time to reassess your loadout!
[*] Faster Lesser Werewolves – These agile cryptids are now even quicker—stay alert.
[*] New Eye Material for Cryptids – Several cryptids now feature a unique new eye material

notes.title: Update e1.16
notes.notes:
[i]This update is primarily a much needed quality of life improvement in many areas of the game. 
These new changes should improve some of the pain points players have been experiencing.[/i]

[h3]Quad Bike handling has been improved and is less prone to flipping[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/837915e7f3cf30a2a71d89b8b14c59446cd7b657.png[/img]

[h3]Recently used vehicles will now have a waypoint for easy tracking[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/e7cd0a4badbe15f74ebcf4384d4424f3eeb20a91.png[/img]

[h3]The favorites bar is now horizontal across the bottom for better usability[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/812016629fcffa04f02dc820611323f47b153166.png[/img]

[h3]Plus many more smaller improvements![/h3]

[h2]Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Decreased stamina cost of rolling
[*] Added invulnerability when rolling
[*] Removed snow from main menu
[*] Removed snow from FOB
[*] Removed Christmas decoration from FOB
[*] Quad Bikes are less prone to killing you in multiplayer
[*] Quad Bike handling has been improved (better steering and less flipping)
[*] Added waypoint for last used vehicle
[*] Improved tire skid effects on dirt
[*] Vehicle skid smoke no longer glows at night
[*] Monsters will flee if the player dodges the attacks multiple times in a row
[*] Weapons no longer get put away when using items from the favorites menu
[*] Favorites bar is now horizontal and at the bottom of the screen
[*] The shortcuts 1,2,3,4,5 on pc now close the favorites bar 
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed some screen effects that were being washed out
[*] Fixed issue where the game would crash upon loading the FOB or Cases
[/list]



[h3]Content updates are in the works and will be coming soon™![/h3]
